content: The judge applied the legal community property regime, distinguishing between personal property and residual common property, in accordance with Articles 177 and 179 of the Civil Code. He recognised that the income derived from the wife's personal property (commercial property) was residual property and therefore common property only to the extent remaining at the date of dissolution of the community, which occurred with the presidential order of separation. He considered that the sums in the joint bank account were the result of joint savings, also taking into account the husband's work, despite his reduced employment. He recognised the compensation of the wife's credit for family expenses and the maintenance of the daughter, excluding, however, those of an alimentary nature, in accordance with Article 447 of the Italian Civil Code and the case law of the Court of Cassation.
